panel.name: The Architect
panel.lens: structure, separation of concerns, and whether the single-file constraint is honored or abused

panel.name: Security Sentinel
panel.lens: secret handling, input trust, network and filesystem blast radius, and failure modes when env vars are missing

panel.name: The Pragmatist
panel.lens: whether this actually does useful work for a real person, or is a template pretending to be a product

panel.name: Docs Desk
panel.lens: the docstring and manifest as documentation — could a stranger install and use this without asking anyone

panel.name: The Maintainer
panel.lens: what this costs to own six months from now — clarity, error handling, and how it fails
